description: Type-membership assertions driven by a type-name descriptor (a string such as 'number', 'string', or 'array'). The relation is satisfied when the actual value is of the named type: 'array' matches any array, while every other name matches when the value's runtime type equals that name. The positive relation reports a violation when the value is not of the named type; the negated relation reports a violation when it IS of that type (its diagnostic reuses the same 'to be a' phrasing). The type descriptor itself must be a string; when it is not (for example a number), the request is rejected with a neutral error category rather than running the comparison.

cases.expected_output:
check=be_a
outcome=violation
message=Expected 'actual' to be a 'number'

check=be_a
outcome=violation
message=Expected 'actual' to be a 'array'

check=not_be_a
outcome=violation
message=Expected 4 to be a 'number'
